ai_models.double_extraction: Every extraction function runs the model twice independently. If the two runs disagree on any threshold, count, value, or matched index, the affected item is marked disputed and the rules engine must return REVIEW for it. Agreement is checked in code, never by asking the model.

fallback.role: One attempt per call after the primary model has failed its retry.

generation_config.response_schema: the Pydantic model for that call, from app/schemas.py

ai_models.timeouts_and_retries: Per logical call: 60 second timeout, one retry on the primary model, then one attempt on the fallback model, then raise ExtractionError.

api_key_contract.format: The entire file content, stripped of leading and trailing whitespace, is the API key. The file may end with a newline.
loading_order: Environment variable GEMINI_API_KEY, if set and non-empty.
File named by environment variable GEMINI_API_KEY_FILE, if that variable is set.
api_key_contract.missing_key_behaviour: If no key is found the app still starts. GET /health reports ai_configured as false. Evaluation returns REVIEW for every criterion with the reason 'AI not configured'. The app must never crash because the key is missing.

data_flow: Officer uploads tender documents in order (main bid first, then corrigenda in date order) to POST /tenders.
Officer uploads one bidder pack per bidder to POST /tenders/{tender_id}/bidders.

POST /tenders/{tender_id}/evaluate runs the pipeline: pdf_text, Gemini extraction (criteria, void list, ATC clauses, bidder evidence), resolver merge, evidence guard, rules engine, ATC flags, matrix and speaking orders.

Results are cached on disk under cache/ keyed by the SHA-256 of all input file bytes in a deterministic order. A repeated evaluation returns the stored result with cached set to true. The cache stores result JSON only, never document text.

coding_agent_rules: Work strictly phase by phase in the order given in phases[]. Do not start a phase until the previous phase gate passes.
After each phase, run the gate commands exactly as written. If a gate fails, fix only the current phase's files and re-run the gate. Do not rewrite earlier phases.
Do not invent library APIs. Use only the APIs named in this spec. If a call fails, check the installed package version before changing approach.

Pin every dependency in requirements.txt to the versions listed in tech_stack. If a pinned version does not exist in the package index, use the closest available patch version and record the change in DECISIONS.md. Never silently change a major version.
Gemini is called from app/gemini_client.py only. No other module imports google.genai or google.generativeai.
All verdict logic lives in app/rules.py as pure functions: no I/O, no network, no AI calls.
Every public function has type hints and a one-line docstring. Keep functions under 40 lines.
Never print, log, or commit the Gemini API key. Never log full document text; log page counts and character counts only.
Where this spec and your own judgement disagree, follow the spec and record the disagreement in DECISIONS.md.
Do not build any frontend beyond the plain server-rendered report page defined in endpoints. No JavaScript frameworks, no CSS frameworks.
demo_survival: Replay cache: after the first successful hero evaluation, every repeat returns the stored result instantly with cached true. The flag is shown honestly in the report page.
Preflight: run scripts/preflight.py 15 minutes before judging. If it fails, demo from localhost with the same code (uvicorn app.main:app --port 8080) using the cached result.
Degraded mode: any AI failure produces REVIEW verdicts with warnings, never a crash and never an HTTP 500 from /evaluate.
Fallback model, temperature 0, and double extraction keep verdicts stable across runs.
Cloud Run min-instances 1 during judging removes cold-start risk.
All fixtures live in the repo, so the full demo needs no external download.
If the venue network fails entirely, the offline unit test suite still demonstrates the rules engine, guard, resolver, and matrix live in the terminal.

endpoints.GET /health: Returns {status: 'ok', ai_configured: bool, model: primary model name}.
endpoints.GET /tenders/{tender_id}/matrix.csv: Returns the matrix as a CSV download (Content-Disposition attachment). Requires a completed evaluation, else 409 JSON.
endpoints.GET /tenders/{tender_id}/report: Returns one plain server-rendered HTML page showing: resolved criteria with sources, the extracted null-and-void list, ATC flags, the matrix table, and speaking-order lines for every FAIL. Inline CSS only. This page is the demo surface.
endpoints.POST /tenders: Multipart form, repeated field name 'files', order preserved as uploaded. Extracts pages for each PDF immediately. Returns {tender_id, documents: [file names], total_pages}. A non-PDF file returns HTTP 400 with a JSON error.
endpoints.POST /tenders/{tender_id}/bidders: Form fields: name (string), files (repeated). Returns {bidder_name, documents: [file names]}. Unknown tender_id returns 404 JSON.
endpoints.POST /tenders/{tender_id}/evaluate: Runs the full pipeline and returns EvaluationResult as JSON. This endpoint must never return HTTP 500: catch ExtractionError and any unexpected exception, and return a degraded EvaluationResult with degraded true, every criterion REVIEW, and warnings containing the exception class name only.

offline_unit_tests: guard: a quote differing only in case and whitespace passes; a quote with one digit changed fails.

golden_cases.synthetic_bidder_pdfs: scripts/make_fixtures.py generates three one-page PDFs with reportlab whose text matches fixtures/extracted/*.json: bidder_pass.pdf (two government orders with execution certificates, OEM authorisation, no-liquidation undertaking), bidder_fail.pdf (one order only, no OEM authorisation), bidder_review.pdf (two orders claimed but the supporting quote in the JSON fixture is deliberately altered so the guard fails).

app/atc_flag.py: flag_clause(clause, void_list) -> AtcFlag. Calls gemini_client.classify_atc_clause, then verifies in code: clause_quote must exist in the clause text and void_quote must exist in the matched void item text (use evidence_guard.quote_exists).

Verdict logic: FLAG when a void item matched and both quotes verify. REVIEW when a void item matched but either quote fails verification, or when the clause is ambiguous (for example it names specific organisations but also permits any government organisation). CLEAR when no void item matched.

Deterministic candidate hints passed into the classification prompt: a clause mentioning a tender fee or bid participation fee nominates the fee item; a clause naming one brand together with the word only nominates the brand item. Hints nominate only; they never decide.
app/evidence_guard.py: quote_exists(quote: str, page_text: str) -> bool. First pass: normalize both, substring test. Second relaxed pass: remove all spaces from both normalised strings, substring test (PDF text layers often break spacing). True if either pass matches.
apply_guard(fields, pages) -> the same fields with guard_passed set. A field whose page number is out of range gets guard_passed False.
app/gemini_client.py: get_client() builds genai.Client from config; raises ExtractionError('AI not configured') when no key.

Every prompt includes the document text with explicit page markers in the form [PAGE 1], [PAGE 2] and instructs the model to cite the page and an exact quote for every item. Quotes must be copied character for character from the text provided.

extract_criteria(pages, doc_name) -> list of Criterion. Extract only explicit eligibility or qualification criteria. Map each to a rule_type; use MANUAL when nothing fits. Fill accepted_doc_types only when the tender names them.
extract_void_list(pages, doc_name) -> list of VoidListItem. Find the Disclaimer section that lists clause types which make the bid null and void. Return every numbered item with its text as written.
extract_atc_clauses(pages, doc_name) -> list of AtcClause. Return the buyer-added bid-specific ATC clauses, both the numbered list and the text-based ATC block.

extract_bidder_evidence(pages, bidder_name, criteria) -> BidderEvidence. For each criterion, find the supporting value, its page, and an exact quote in the bidder pack. Also list documents_present using the doc_type vocabulary from the schemas.

classify_atc_clause(clause, void_list) -> draft AtcFlag. The model returns matched_void_index or null, the exact clause quote, the exact void item quote, and a short reason. Final verdict is decided in app/atc_flag.py after quote verification, not here.
Each function performs double extraction and marks disputed items as defined in ai_models.
app/jobs.py: In-memory store: tenders keyed by tender_id (uuid4 hex). Each tender keeps its documents in upload order (name plus bytes plus extracted pages) and its bidders in upload order.
cache_key(tender) -> SHA-256 hex of the concatenation of tender document bytes then bidder document bytes, in stored order.
load_cached(key) and save_cached(key, result): JSON files under cache/. Cached EvaluationResult is returned with cached set to true.
app/matrix.py: build_matrix(criteria, results) -> list of rows; each row is the criterion title followed by one verdict per bidder, bidders in upload order.
to_csv(matrix, bidder_names) -> CSV string with header row: Criterion, then bidder names.
to_html(matrix, bidder_names) -> a standalone HTML table string with inline CSS only, no external assets, verdict cells coloured lightly: PASS green, FAIL red, REVIEW amber.
app/numbers.py: parse_money_to_inr(text: str) -> float or None. Must handle: 'Rs 50,00,000', 'Rs 50 lakh', 'INR 1.2 crore', 'Rs. 2,50,000/-', '75,000'. Remove Indian grouping commas. lakh means times 100000, crore means times 10000000. Return None when no number is present.
parse_count(text: str) -> int or None. Returns the first integer in the text.
app/pdf_text.py: extract_pages(pdf_bytes: bytes) -> list of PageText{page: int, text: str}. Use pypdf.PdfReader on io.BytesIO. Page numbers are 1-based.

normalize(text: str) -> str: lowercase, convert curly quotes to straight quotes, collapse every run of whitespace to a single space, strip. This one function is used by the guard and by comparisons everywhere.
has_text_layer(pages) -> bool: true when total non-whitespace characters across pages is at least 200.
app/resolver.py: resolve_criteria(docs_in_order) -> merged list of Criterion. Key is Criterion.id. A later document overrides an earlier document with the same id; set supersedes on the winner. Criteria that appear only in older documents remain valid.
resolve_void_list(lists_in_order) -> the void list from the last document that produced a non-empty list.
app/rules.py: evaluate(criterion, evidence) -> CriterionResult without bidder_name; the caller fills bidder_name. Pure function.
rule_type MANUAL always returns REVIEW with reason 'Needs officer judgement'.
A disputed field, or a field with guard_passed False, counts as no evidence.

DOC_PRESENT: PASS when documents_present contains any of accepted_doc_types, or any document at all when accepted_doc_types is empty. FAIL when no matching document is present; the reason must state that the tender makes an offer liable to rejection when a sought document is not uploaded.
UNDERTAKING_PRESENT: PASS when a document of doc_type undertaking is present, else FAIL.
OEM_OR_AUTHORISED: PASS when a document of doc_type OEM authorisation is present, else FAIL.
MIN_COUNT: the evidence field value is the count. No field returns REVIEW with reason 'No verified evidence found'. value >= threshold returns PASS. value < threshold returns FAIL.

MIN_AVG_VALUE: average every guard-passed field value for the criterion (one field per financial year). Fewer than 3 yearly values returns REVIEW. Average >= threshold returns PASS, otherwise FAIL. All money values must already be normalised to INR by app/numbers.py before comparison.
Every FAIL gets speaking_order_line filled by app/speaking_order.py. PASS and REVIEW never get one.
app/speaking_order.py: line_for(bidder_name, criterion, result) -> string in exactly this shape: The bid of {bidder_name} is rejected under {criterion.title} ({criterion.source_doc}, page {criterion.source_page}): {result.reason} Criterion as per tender: {criterion.source_quote}

out_of_scope: Any frontend beyond the plain server-rendered /report page. The frontend decision is made only after the backend passes all gates.
User accounts, login, or access control.
A database. State is in memory; results are cached as JSON files.
OCR or vision processing of scanned documents. A document without a text layer produces REVIEW verdicts with the explicit reason that the document has no readable text layer.
Storing uploaded documents after the process ends.

hero_fixture.corrigendum: GEM/2026/B/7945477-C5 dated 08-09-2026, issued by IIT Kanpur
facts_verified_from_the_document: The corrigendum states in its own text that it supersedes all previous versions of the bid-specific Additional Terms and Conditions.
Its Disclaimer lists exactly 14 clause types that make a bid null and void.

Clause 4 of its text-based ATC demands at least two orders from IITs, NITs or any other government organisation. This is a genuine REVIEW case against Disclaimer item 8 (seeking experience from a specific organisation only).

Its experience-proof clause accepts three document types: contract copy with invoices and self-certification by the bidder; execution certificate by the client with contract value; any other document in support of contract execution such as a third-party inspection release note.

Other usable criteria in it: 50 percent option clause, no-liquidation undertaking, OEM or authorised dealer only, dedicated toll-free number for service support, escalation matrix for service support.

project.name: BidParakh
project.summary: A backend service that helps a government procurement officer evaluate bids submitted on the GeM portal. It ingests a tender (main bid PDF plus corrigenda), resolves the currently valid criteria (latest corrigendum wins), extracts the null-and-void ATC clause list from the corrigendum's own Disclaimer, extracts bidder evidence from bid PDFs, verifies every extracted value against the source text (evidence guard), and produces deterministic PASS / FAIL / REVIEW verdicts from a pure-Python rules engine, a criteria-by-bidder matrix, draft speaking-order lines for every FAIL, and ATC legality flags. Gemini is used only for extraction and clause classification. Gemini never decides a verdict.
project.tagline: Officer-side GeM bid evaluation: AI reads, code decides.

Criterion.accepted_doc_types: list of strings; empty unless the tender names accepted document types
Criterion.id: string slug, stable for the same requirement across documents, for example exp_orders, oem_authorisation, liquidation_undertaking
Criterion.rule_type: one of MIN_COUNT, MIN_AVG_VALUE, DOC_PRESENT, UNDERTAKING_PRESENT, OEM_OR_AUTHORISED, MANUAL
Criterion.source_doc: string, file name the criterion came from
Criterion.source_quote: string, exact quote from the source document
Criterion.supersedes: list of criterion ids this criterion replaced; filled by the resolver, empty at extraction time
Criterion.title: string, short human title
Criterion.unit: string or null, for example orders or INR

CriterionResult.reason: string, plain language, states the values compared
CriterionResult.speaking_order_line: string or null, set only when verdict is FAIL

DocumentPresent.doc_type: string, one of: contract copy, invoice, execution certificate, OEM authorisation, undertaking, escalation matrix, toll-free evidence, other

ExtractedField.disputed: bool, set when double extraction disagreed
ExtractedField.guard_passed: bool, set only by app/evidence_guard.py, never by the model
ExtractedField.page: int, 1-based page in the bidder document
ExtractedField.quote: string, exact quote supporting the value
ExtractedField.raw_text: string as it appears in the document, for example Rs 1.2 crore

schemas.Verdict: Enum with exactly three values: PASS, FAIL, REVIEW.

VoidListItem.index: int, position in the Disclaimer list starting at 1
VoidListItem.text: string, the clause type as written in the Disclaimer

tech_stack.ai_sdk: google-genai, the official Google Gen AI SDK for Python. Use genai.Client(api_key=...), client.models.generate_content with a Pydantic response_schema for structured output. Never parse free-text model output by hand.
